title: Installment Service Fee on Self-Pay Visit Package Refunds
content:
**Fee schedule — Self-Pay Visit Package refunds.** The installment service fee follows the installment payments received on the package: **$15.00** for three or more, **$10.00** for two, none for one. The fee is subtracted from the refund.

| Installment payments received on the package | Installment service fee |
|---|---|
| 1 (including a single payment in full) | none |
| 2 | $10.00 |
| 3 or more | $15.00 |

**Notes.** Installment payments are the payments recorded in the package history as installments; a payment in full at the sale is one installment payment. Reinstatement-fee payments are not installment payments and are not counted.

*Hypothetical:* a package paid in 3 installments, all received, carries a $15.00 installment service fee on its refund; one paid in 2 installments carries $10.00.
